title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Global Polio
summary: Some international destinations have circulating poliovirus. Before any international travel, make sure you are up to date on your polio vaccines. Country List : Afghanistan, Algeria, Benin, Cameroon, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast), Democratic Republic of the Congo, Niger, Nigeria, Pakistan, Soma

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Hepatitis A in Costa Rica
summary: There is an outbreak of hepatitis A (HAV) in Costa Rica. Most cases have been reported in San José province.

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Colombia
summary: An increased number of cases of yellow fever have been reported in Colombia.

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 1 - Global Dengue
summary: Dengue is a year-round risk in many parts of the world, with outbreaks commonly occurring every 2–5 years. Travelers to risk areas should prevent mosquito bites. Country List : Colombia, Vietnam, Maldives, Bolivia, Cambodia, Kenya, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Costa Rica, Marshall Islands, Vanua

title: CDC travel health notice, Level 2 - Chikungunya in Nicaragua
summary: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Nicaragua. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.
